scope: Read-only review of graph storage wiring and sparse initial mapped projection; no runtime verification
sparseBound: With validated directories and matching IDs, exactMatchesCanFillLimit false proves summed predicate posting occurrences < limit; union nodes and distinct projected rows cannot exceed that sum. Overlap/repeated OR terms can only force conservative fallback.
matchingNodeIds: Selected posting validation is eager before sequence publication; physical-order heap merge is lazy and deduplicates node IDs. Null fallback occurs before projection rows are returned.
emptyDuplicateNullGraphId: IDs provide query-local tuple equality; supported negative property indexes map to -1/null; empty projection yields a single empty tuple if any candidate; repeated/reordered properties remain in their original column positions. GraphId substitution remains at QueryPipeline.
selectedFallback: Only complete-four-property selectedValues uses mapped selectedProjectionHits; partial projections return null to original exact discovery/raw/retained fallback. Any partial internally found rows are discarded if selected API returns null on invalid later posting.
sequenceCancellation: Producer finally is not guaranteed on consumer break/throw. Safety here is explicit merge accounting.flush before every yield, no resource held across yield requiring close, and consumer own finally flush; producer-internal exceptions execute its finally. Normal valid sparse path cannot reach LIMIT since occurrence sum is already below it.
accounting: Directory/validation/merge retain original accounting; projection charges each visited node; exceptions propagate. Added index/projection lookup counter reflects the newly used path and is not evidence of latency progress.
